LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 2.3.1 WORD CLASS: COLLECTIVE NOUNS/ REFLEXIVE PRONOUNS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Class: Collective Nouns/ Reflexive Pronouns, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade five General.

Key inquiry question: which collective nouns and reflexive pronouns (myself, ourselves) have been used in sentences, 1. How do you emphasise that you did something on your own?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
